subject.title: [Feature]: 希望支持敏感数据脱敏

question: Which security model should OpenClaw adopt for sensitive-data protection across config at rest, diagnostics/log sinks, and user-visible/UI surfaces?
rationale: The remaining work defines key custody, migration, recovery, diagnostic policy, and user-visible redaction behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent boundary without maintainer/security intent.

options.title: Keep Umbrella And Split Work
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers drive narrower sub-issues for config encryption/backups, diagnostic sink policy, and any remaining UI/API sweep.

options.title: Rely On Narrow Trackers
options.body: Close this umbrella only if maintainers decide https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/43794, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/43830, and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/10659 fully replace it.

options.title: Declare Existing Mitigations Enough
options.body: Document SecretRefs, 0600 permissions, and current redaction as the supported boundary and explicitly defer native encryption/output masking.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella And Split Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers drive narrower sub-issues for config encryption/backups, diagnostic sink policy, and any remaining UI/API sweep.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the live assignee and authored the maintainer-member backlog that currently defines this umbrella's remaining scope.
